title: [YouPass Collect] - University Sports Centre Changes: 2007 vs Present Day
prompt: The picture shows the map of a University Sports Centre in 2007 and at present. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The two maps illustrate the changes that have taken place at a university sports centre between 2007 and the present day.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the sports centre has undergone significant expansion and modernisation over this period. Most notably, the teaching facilities have more than doubled in number, and several new amenities have been added, including a running track in the north and medical facilities in the south.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the northern and central areas, the football pitch, which occupied the northernmost part of the centre in 2007, has been upgraded from a grass surface to an all-weather pitch. Directly below it, a new running track has been constructed, which did not exist in the original layout. Moving southward, while the swimming pool has remained in its original position on the western side, the adjacent tennis court has been replaced by a squash court.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the teaching and support facilities, in 2007, there were only 20 teaching rooms in the central block, along with temporary teaching huts on the eastern edge of the complex. By the present day, the number of teaching facilities has increased dramatically to 47, and the temporary huts have been removed. Furthermore, the southern boundary of the centre now features several new additions, namely a first aid room, a clinic, a laboratory, and a two-storeyed teaching building, none of which existed in the earlier layout.
